اكتأبت (form VIII)
# اِكْتَأَبْتُ (iktaʔabtu) /ik.ta.ʔab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# اِكْتَأَبْتَ (iktaʔabta) /ik.ta.ʔab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# اِكْتَأَبْتِ (iktaʔabti) /ik.ta.ʔab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِكْتَأَبَ (iktaʔaba)
# اِكْتَأَبَتْ (iktaʔabat) /ik.ta.ʔa.bat/: third-perso
